title.name: Manimekalai
title.subtitle: The First Handful
title.tagline: Your choices about how to help — and who carries the work on.

options.title: Options
options.note: No timers. You can pause any time.
options.pendingTamil: Tamil is being reviewed; English is shown for now.

hud.moveHint: Use the arrow keys or WASD to walk.
hud.ledgerHintOnce: Press J to see what Manimekalai knows.

prompt.seeWater: See what's happening at the well

journal.title: What Manimekalai knows
journal.subtitle: Tap a line to say how she knows it.
journal.empty: Nothing yet. Look around, and listen to people.
journal.hint: This is just to help you think. There are no wrong answers.

status.confirmed: I thought this was true — and now I have seen it is.
status.challenged: I thought this was true — but now I have seen otherwise.
status.uncertain: I am still not sure about this.

helper.neighbour: a young neighbour from the lane
helper.weaver: a weaver who stayed to help

did.water: A neighbour keeps water coming to the yard. The young man can drink now.
did.crowd: A helper keeps the path calm and open. The mother can come through.
did.carry: A helper carries a warm portion across to Paati.

helper.freeThem: Ask them to rest for now
helper.jobLapsed: You freed a helper — that job is uncovered again.
helper.allBusy: Both helpers are busy. Move one here — or do it another way?
helper.movedHere: You moved a helper here. Their last job needs someone again.
helper.allBusyPaati: Both helpers are busy. You could carry to Paati yourself.

paati.how: How should Paati get her food?
paati.helper: Ask a helper to carry it

react.youngManRevised: The young man nods. "Next time, let us fill the water pots first."
react.childRemembers: The child remembers you came to Paati first, and holds your hand.
react.motherVolunteers: The mother steps up. "I can keep the line in order, if you like."
react.locALean: People wait for your word before they move. They have learned to look to you.

puhar.intro: Morning in Puhar, by the sea.
puhar.childWave: A small child waves at you.
puhar.toSquare: The child leads you toward the food yard. Follow when you are ready.

child.cantReach: But we can't get to it.
child.watchTry: The child runs toward the food… then stops, and comes back to Paati.
child.afterTry: The path is too full. They can't get through.

mani.seeThem: Food, right there. And they cannot reach it.
mani.why: Why can't they eat, when the food is so close?
mani.afterFail: That did not work. Some of them still have not eaten.
mani.endThought: The bowl will leave when I do. Someone here must keep it going.

carrier.name: Water-carrier
carrier.l2: But the well is far. They can't carry water home.
carrier.afterListen: The water-carrier lifts a heavy pot and nods toward the yard.

know.childFood: A hungry child cannot reach the food.
know.paatiCannot: Paati cannot walk through the crowd to the food.
know.wellFar: The well is far; some people have food but no water.
know.consChild: The child and Paati are still waiting, outside the crowd.
know.consWater: The young man has food, but no water to take it home.
know.consMother: The mother is pushed back by the crowd, holding her child.

bowl.reveal1: A bowl is placed in your hands. It fills, and does not empty.
bowl.reveal2: There is food for everyone now.
bowl.hope: "Now they can all eat," you think.

square.intro: The food yard. Paati and the child are here — and others, waiting.
square.beforeServe: Look around first. Talk to people. Share the food when you are ready.
square.helpersIntro: Two neighbours have stayed to help. I can ask each of them to do one thing — and move them if I need to.
square.paatiHere: Paati sits at the edge. She cannot reach the middle.
square.youngManHere: A young man waits, holding an empty water pot.
square.motherHere: A mother stands back from the crowded path, holding her child.

act.setDone: You set out a mat and vessels to serve from.
act.waterDone: A helper carries water to the yard. The young man can drink now.
act.pathDone: A helper opens a calm path. The mother can come through.
act.paatiDone: You carry a warm portion to Paati yourself.
act.needVessel: Set a serving place first — a mat and a vessel.
act.noHelpers: Both helpers are busy. Free one, or do it yourself.

square.serveEarly: You share the food. The bowl never empties — but not everyone can reach it.
square.revise: Manimekalai stops, and looks at who is still waiting.
square.allReady: Water is here. The path is open. Paati has her portion.

people.youngManAsk: "I have rice. But no water to carry it home."
people.motherAsk: "I can't get through with my little one."
people.paatiWait: "Go on without me, child. I cannot reach it."

ending.serve: This time, the food reaches them all.
ending.paatiEats: Paati eats, slowly. Her shoulders drop.
ending.childSmile: The child leans against her, and smiles.
ending.afterPoidhum: But the yard is not empty yet. There is a little more to do.
ending.aftermath1: You will leave soon, and the bowl goes with you.
ending.aftermath2: A helper from this yard says she will keep the water coming.

after.intro: The people are fed. You begin to gather yourself to leave.
after.waterLow: "Manimekalai — the well is running low. What do we do when you're gone?"
after.youngManSteps: "Leave the water to me. I know the well now. I'll keep it coming."
after.motherSteps: "Go — I'll keep the line in order and see the water shared fairly."
after.localsWait: The people look to you, and wait. No one steps forward on their own.
after.askYoungMan: Ask the young man to keep the water
after.askMother: Ask the mother to keep the line
after.tentative: "I… I can try. If you think I can." They are not sure yet.
after.canLeave: The yard can manage now. You may leave when you are ready.
after.childRemembers: "You came to Paati first. She told me. Thank you."
after.paatiThanks: Paati rests a hand on the child's head. "We are all right now."
after.alreadyResolved: The work is in good hands. You can go when you're ready.

finale.leave: You leave the yard as the serving goes on behind you.
finale.ownerMother: The mother keeps the line calm and fair. The yard holds together without you.
finale.ownerYoungMan: The young man carries water without being asked. The work has its own hands now.
finale.ownerMani: The people still glance to where you stood, waiting for a word. You wonder: did I help, or did I make myself the one they need?
finale.unresolved: Some things are still unsettled. That is how it is. You have done what you could, today.

journey.title: Your journey through this prototype
journey.firstPath: You began by opening the path.
journey.firstServe: You began by sharing food, and learned from what happened.
journey.listenedLots: You listened to people before you acted.
journey.actedFast: You acted quickly, and learned as you went.
journey.paatiFirst: You reached Paati before the first sharing.
journey.servedEarly: You shared food before everyone could reach it, then made it right.
journey.revised: You changed your plan after seeing who was left out.
journey.reassigned: You moved your helpers as the needs changed.
journey.ownerMother: The mother took the work on after you.
journey.ownerYoungMan: The young man took the water on after you.
journey.ownerMani: The work still leaned on you when you left.
journey.ownerNone: The work's future was left unsettled.

summary.title: For the grown-up watching (a note, not a score)

system.migrated: This prototype has changed. Your settings were kept; start a new 0.3 game to play.
